subject: Energy
title: Chernobyl
description: A short lesson to help you apply Chernobyl.

hook.text: On April 26, 1986, reactor 4 at Chernobyl exploded—the worst nuclear disaster in history.

buildup.text: A safety test went wrong—operators disabled safety systems, and a power surge caused a steam explosion.

discovery.text: The graphite moderator caught fire—burning for 10 days and sending radioactive fallout across Europe.

twist.text: The RBMK reactor design had a fatal flaw—at low power, it became dangerously unstable, and operators didn't know.

climax.text: 31 workers died immediately; thousands later developed cancers—a 30-km exclusion zone remains today.

punchline.text: A flawed design, a flawed test—and a city became a ghost town.

quiz.question: What design flaw contributed to the Chernobyl disaster?
options: The RBMK design was unstable at low power
